recognition_trigger: After confirming a streak start in an unordered set, count the run through successor membership rather than positional operations.
corrected_rule: Keep a current value and run length; while current value plus one is in the set, increment both.
why_failed: Sets do not support meaningful indexing or slicing, and sorting is unnecessary when constant-time membership can establish each successor.
application: Initialize the run length at one for the confirmed start, repeatedly test the next integer in the set, advance the current value and length while present, then compare that length with the maximum.
